description:
Forge is an unofficial rules engine for the world's greatest card game.
This world allows you to play the adventure mode with archipelago support.

APWorld-0.1.0.description:
Based on APQuest 8ca584be93d6707ebd35773cb85dc3e76aeb27e9

**First release of the Forge Adventure mode APWorld project.**
The project supports forge-archipelago which can be found [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/tree/dev_archipelago).

**Make sure to read `ARCHIPELAGO.md` for instructions on how to use & set up the Archipelago mode [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/blob/dev_archipelago/ARCHIPELAGO.md).**

Check out the [requirements doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z1r4p_NAsm1oOKPqkfo45QEBCeYHCi71h6-LmySQdt4/edit?usp=sharing) for our progress.
APWorld-0.1.0.title: Forge APWorld v0.1.0

APWorld-0.1.1.description:
Based on APQuest 8ca584be93d6707ebd35773cb85dc3e76aeb27e9

**Hotfix for Forge Adventure mode APWorld project.**
The project supports forge-archipelago which can be found [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/tree/dev_archipelago).

**Make sure to read `ARCHIPELAGO.md` for instructions on how to use & set up the Archipelago mode [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/blob/dev_archipelago/ARCHIPELAGO.md).**

Check out the [requirements doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z1r4p_NAsm1oOKPqkfo45QEBCeYHCi71h6-LmySQdt4/edit?usp=sharing) for our progress.

### Changelog
- Fixed a bug where an increase of total cards collected locations would lead to the equipment shops no longer populating and "unknown locations" appearing in the AP client console.
- Removed unnecessary boss locations.
APWorld-0.1.1.title: Forge APWorld v0.1.1

APWorld-0.2.0.description:
Based on APQuest https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-APWorld/commit/8ca584be93d6707ebd35773cb85dc3e76aeb27e9

The project supports forge-archipelago which can be found [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/tree/dev_archipelago).

Make sure to read ARCHIPELAGO.md for instructions on how to use & set up the Archipelago mode [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/blob/dev_archipelago/ARCHIPELAGO.md).

Check out the [requirements doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z1r4p_NAsm1oOKPqkfo45QEBCeYHCi71h6-LmySQdt4/edit?usp=sharing) for our progress.

Changelog
* Added ability set set your starting inventory, including:
  * Individual cards
  * Set unlocks
  * Boosters
  * Equipment
* Added option to set the minimum number of obtainable Set Unlock checks before being required to beat a (mini)boss
* Added option to remove the starting deck the player usually obtains when starting the game
* Implemented Deathlink:
  * In-battle: A trigger goes on the stack to make you lose life equal to your current HP
  * Overworld/Dungeon: You get the effects of losing a standard battle (life/gold is reduced, you also get teleported to spawn or the overworld as normal)
* Added a new optional final boss "Arzakon"
* The "Short", "Medium" and "Long" templates were adjusted based on playtest results.
APWorld-0.2.0.title: Forge APWorld v0.2.0
